component.name: VeroRoute
component.summary: Circuit layout software for Veroboard (stripboard), Perfboard and simple PCBs

description.p: Cross-platform software for producing Veroboard (stripboard), perfboard, and 1-layer or 2-layer PCB layouts.
Automatically prevents short-circuits and checks for open-circuits.
Import a netlist from a gEDA or KiCad schematic, or specify the netlist graphically.
Gerber export for easy 1-layer or 2-layer professional PCB manufacture.
